purpose: Story095 old factory aftershock condenser landing savepoint and respawn anchor prop
postprocess: Generated on a flat chroma-key background
Trimmed, centered, and resized to 256x256 transparent PNG for Godot runtime import
prompt: Create a single old-factory aftershock condenser savepoint relay, a compact waist-high repair station/anchor for a cat action game. It should look like a brass-and-steel condenser relay pedestal with small copper coils, pressure gauge, ceramic insulators, faint cyan ember lights, worn bolts, soot, and a paw-scale activation plate. No characters. Centered full object on a perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background, no shadow, no text, no UI, no watermark.
negative_prompt: square placeholders, simple colored rectangles, text labels, logos, multiple objects, character silhouettes, smoke, particles, glass transparency, neon green details
